_comment: Tile copy for each case study, keyed by slug. Editable in the browser under `npm run dev` — see tools/copy-editor.mjs. One file rather than per-study, because the same tile renders in two places: the index, and the next-study link at the foot of the other study. Edit it in either and both change. src/data/studies.ts keeps the structure — slug, cover image, archived — and reads these strings from here.

machine-readable-components.title: A component library a machine could read
machine-readable-components.summary: Expedia Group had three drifting implementations of every component. A machine read all three and proposed a rebuild, and my job was to overrule it where it was wrong and write the decision back in a form it could build from.
machine-readable-components.coverAlt: An abstract still life in violet and off-white: frosted glass panels showing a component grid, a list, a card and a block of code, wired together by glowing cables into a central lit tile.

making-the-app-testable.title: The app that could not be tested
making-the-app-testable.summary: Hotels.com's two most valuable screens were both fixed layouts, so nothing on them could vary and nothing could be learned from them. Rebuilding both is what made a continuous testing programme possible.
making-the-app-testable.coverAlt: An abstract still life in sage green and off-white: frosted glass panels showing a search field over a list of results, a detail view, a set of filters and a bar chart, linked by glowing cables.

search-experience.title: Search, rebuilt so it could be tested
search-experience.summary: The Hotels.com app showed search results in a card framework that nothing could be varied inside. Rebuilding it as dynamic cards turned the app's most valuable screen into one the team could learn from.
search-experience.coverAlt: An abstract still life in sage green and off-white: frosted glass panels showing a search field over a list of results, a detail view, a set of filters and a bar chart, linked by glowing cables.

scaling-a-system.title: Consolidating four design systems into one
scaling-a-system.summary: A brand consolidation meant collapsing several independent design systems into a single platform, without flattening the brands that depended on them.
